Description: Kunhuta is the noble kinswoman of Sir Albert of Slivna, reared in tranquil manorial halls overlooking the upper reaches of the Vltava. Gentle, prudent, and perceptive, she mastered weaving, herbal apothecary arts, and estate reckoning, assuming the stewardship of family halls and tenant welfare while her male kin campaigned far afield with the royal host. Constantly concerned for the survival of loved ones in perilous campaigns, she offers daily prayers in the castle chapel, navigating regional noble alliances with cautious intelligence to preserve her house's steadfast royalist alignment. Her serene fortitude and loyal dedication provide a peaceful haven amidst the harsh realities of wartime Bohemia. Tending wounded veterans at Slivna and cultivating medicinal herbs in manor gardens to produce healing salves, Kunhuta won the deep devotion of common serfs and soldiers alike. Prudently assisting her kinsmen in auditing feudal tithes while maintaining dignified reserve against predatory suitors from neighboring baronies, she preserved her family's pristine honor amid turbulent frontier politics. Her tender compassion, practical wisdom, and steadfast loyalty brought radiant peace and enduring honor to her ancestral manor, faithfully shielding her household, vassals, and tenants through decades of relentless frontier warfare.
Motivations: Prudently manage Slivna's household and serf harvests, providing reliable funds for campaigning armor and horses.
Secure honorable dynastic alliances to ensure political safety and pray for her kin's safe return.
Values: Regards fidelity, modesty, and selfless devotion to kin as the crowning virtues of noblewomen.
Believes patient, quiet resilience conquers all wartime hardships more effectively than pride.
Fears: Dreads receiving catastrophic casualty reports from the front that leave Slivna Castle defenseless.
Fears foreign war ravaging peaceful manors, burning ancestral fields and weaving mills.
SpeechStyle: While lances fight in distant lands, prayers endure within our walls; may Heaven guide our knights safely home and keep our hearths alight. In council or on campaign, our royal laws and covenants admit no compromise.
Name: Kunhuta of Slivna
